Chapter 5 - Telephone Manager Messages / Telephone Manager Message Reference
Constants

Conference Split States

The telCAConferenceSplitMsg message (page 5-21) indicates whether an attempt to split a call appearance from a conference was successful. The value parameter contains one of the following constants. 
enum {
   telConferenceSplitFailed= 0,
   telConferenceSplitEst   = 1
};
Constant descriptions
telConferenceSplitFailed
Could not split a call appearance from a conference.
telConferenceSplitEst
Split a call appearance from a conference.
